instruction:
Run `C:\Users\user\Desktop\abm_vs_real.cir` in native PSpice. Use the native PSpice command-line simulator `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\psp_cmd.exe`. Before starting the work, use `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe` for OrCAD schematics and `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\allegro.exe` for board work.

Save the native simulator output as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\abm_vs_real.out`. From the AC sweep table in that `.out`, compare `VDB(OUT_ABM)` and `VDB(OUT_SK)` over the whole sweep and write `C:\Users\user\Desktop\compare.json` with `max_abs_diff_dB`, `rms_diff_dB`, `n_points`, and `passes_spec`. Set `passes_spec` to true exactly when `max_abs_diff_dB < 0.5` dB; otherwise set it to false.
